name: Tranquil Bowprod
description: Seat two bolts head to tail in the groove so they leave the rail one after the other.

name: Nimble Trigger
description: Step on the body beat and loose on the qi beat so the two tracks of the school keep time.

name: Luminous Stock
description: Call the point of impact aloud to the partner so both bolts aim at the same spot.

name: Inferno Setback
description: Loose the first bolt and let the second follow within a breath at the same mark.

name: Benevolent Latch
description: Seat the second bolt in the same motion as the release of the first.

name: Deluge Boltrail
description: Reset the feet after the pair of shots and shift to a new angle of fire.

name: Twangcrown
description: Send the first bolt to break the guard and the second into the opening it makes.

name: Squall Twang
description: Gather qi on both tracks for a breath and loose a bolt and its twin as one stroke.

name: Prismsear
description: Loose a great pair of bolts carrying the full qi of both tracks into a single guarded point.

name: Valiant Span
description: Loose a bolt and its twin so close that both enter the same wound and no guard can answer them.

name: Searbenison
description: Set the feet narrow and the shoulders high in the stance of the hawk court before the shot.

name: Luminous Cranequin
description: Check the straightness and the balance of the chosen bolt and reject any that fails.

name: Interstice Tripbar
description: Narrow the sight to a single point on the mark and ignore all else in the field.

name: Stocktriumph
description: Loose the checked bolt at the point fixed by the sight and hold the pose after.

name: Bedrock Cranking
description: Move to a fresh perch in the pace of the court and set the stance again.

name: Tranquil Stirrup
description: Count the beats of an easy breath while waiting so the hand is calm when the mark appears.

name: Latchgift
description: Take in the whole field from a height with one slow glance and fix on the best mark.

name: Sigil Windlass
description: Pin the foe's cloak or sleeve to the ground with a bolt so the foe cannot step clear.

name: Pulsar Releaseclack
description: Loose a bolt filled with qi so it drives past a raised shield into the body.

name: Radiance Boltrail
description: Loose a great bolt from a high perch so it stoops onto the mark with the whole force of the shooter.

name: Intrepid Cranequin
description: Wait on a high perch and loose at the one instant the mark is still so the bolt falls on it without a miss.

name: Twilit Trigger
description: Dress the rank along the basin bank so each shoulder is level with the next.

name: Vigor Windlass
description: Pass out the day's quarrels along the rank so each shooter holds the same number.

name: Volition Latch
description: Rest the bows along the lip of the bank so the whole rank aims steadily.

name: Revelation Stirrup
description: Give the count of the loose in a voice that the whole rank can hear.

name: Prismspan
description: Loose along the line on the count so the bolts rise together over the basin.

name: Squallspan
description: Pass through the rank in turn so spanned bows come forward and emptied bows go back.

name: Clement Stock
description: Pass spanned bows hand to hand along the line so the front never lacks a loaded bow.

name: Revelation Sear
description: Listen for the call of the line leader and hold the loose until the word is given.

name: Searedict
description: Loose the whole rank together with qi in each bolt so a heavy volley falls across a wide patch.

name: Statute Twang
description: Hold the whole rank spanned and ready and loose at one word to pin an advancing foe.

name: Thunderous Sear
description: Loose a rank of great bolts with full qi so the volley breaks a massed formation.

name: Dunestock
description: Hold the whole rank in one unbroken rhythm of loosing so a sheet of bolts covers the field.

name: Parity Bowprod
description: Set both feet in the stirrup bar and square the hips under the load of the drawn prod.

name: Benevolent Tripbar
description: Draw the prod to a slow count that matches the pace of the river.

name: Vigor Sear
description: Rest the limbs of the prod between draws so they keep their spring.

name: Cranking Verdict
description: Loose the fully drawn prod at a short measured pull of the trigger.

name: Delugetwang
description: Slide along the bank with the heavy prod at the hip to keep pace with a moving foe.

name: Gracious Bowprod
description: Link each draw to the last in a chain so the prod is never left unspanned for long.

name: Eclipse Boltrail
description: Listen to the sound of the drawing string to know when the limbs are fully set.

name: Prismlatch
description: Loose from the full draw with qi in the limbs so the bolt breaks through a shield.

name: Steel Quarrel
description: Hold the drawn prod at its limit while qi gathers and then release it as one blow.

name: Paramount Span
description: Loose a great draw of the prod with full qi so the bolt shatters heavy cover.

name: Fearless Quarrel
description: Hold the drawn prod at its limit until the foe commits and then loose a bolt that ends the matter.

name: Paritysear
description: Set a long stable stance with the front foot toward the mark and the bow high.

name: Pealsear
description: Pick out a far mark in clear air and judge its distance by its size.

name: Eclipse Cranequin
description: Count the paces of a moving mark across a far field to learn its speed.

name: Vigorlatch
description: Draw on a long slow breath so the full stored force is ready for a far shot.

name: Radiance Setback
description: Loose a long flat shot at a far mark and follow its flight with the eye.

name: Windlass Heraldry
description: Take a long step to a new post that keeps the distant mark in the same line.

name: Peallatch
description: Hold the aim on a moving far mark and let it walk into the line.

name: Vigor Tripbar
description: Span and seat the next bolt without lowering the gaze from the far mark.

name: Magnificent Quarrel
description: Loose a charged bolt along a long line so it still pierces a guard at the far mark.

name: Radiance Stock
description: Hold a long breath while qi gathers and loose one bolt at a mark beyond usual range.

name: Pulsar Latch
description: Loose a great bolt along the far line with full qi so it strikes heavy cover at its limit.

name: Storied Twang
description: Compress the qi into a thin bolt that travels far and strikes a distant mark through its guard.

name: Serene Trigger
description: Stand square beneath the high sun and raise the twin prod to the line of the shoulders.

name: Eclipse Sear
description: Clear the eye of glare and fix the sight on the mark through the bright air.

name: Bloomsear
description: Hold a deep breath at the peak of the draw until the Core steadies the arms.

name: Peal Stirrup
description: Loose the twin prod in one beat with the Core feeding both limbs.

name: Evanescent Setback
description: Rise onto the toes in a short hop that lifts the aim over a low obstacle.

name: Volition Windlass
description: Draw both limbs in a single chain of Core and arm so the twin prod is always ready.

name: Paramount Stirrup
description: Loose a bolt filled with Core qi so it pierces plate and the body behind it.

name: Setback Verdict
description: Hold the twin prod at full draw while the Core gathers and release the whole store at once.

name: Gallant Span
description: Loose a great bolt from the Core so it breaks the strongest cover in its path.

name: Vacuumsear
description: Loose both prods at the height of the draw so their bolts fall together from above on one mark.

name: Bloomstock
description: Stand near the plateau edge with the feet wide and the oath spoken under the breath.

name: Peal Trigger
description: Sight along the sworn bolt to the mark and speak the mark aloud once.

name: Stockmercy
description: Count the breath against the pulse of the wind until the hands are still.

name: Latchverdict
description: Loose the sworn bolt only when the oath and the aim agree.

name: Bedrock Releaseclack
description: Move along the plateau with the oath held fixed on the mark.

name: Searmercy
description: Reload while keeping the oath and the bearing in the mind so no shot is wasted.

name: Revelation Stock
description: Glance at the far landmark to confirm the bearing has not shifted.

name: Fearless Bowprod
description: Loose a charged bolt along the sworn line so it pierces the guard of the mark.

name: Vacuumspan
description: Hold the sworn bolt through a long gust and loose it the moment the wind drops.

name: Pulsarstock
description: Loose a great bolt sworn to a mark with full qi so it holds its line and breaks the guard.

name: Peerless Cranking
description: Swear one bolt to one mark and hold its qi until aim and oath agree and then loose it.

name: Paritylatch
description: Stand in the open with no cover at hand and the bow held low and ready.

name: Lifegiving Tripbar
description: Take a firm two handed grip on the tiller that a gust cannot loosen.

name: Wise Latch
description: Pick a mark against the open sky and judge its distance by the haze.

name: Valiant Cranking
description: Loose from open ground at a mark in the open with the bow held steady.

name: Releaseclack Grace
description: Move forward in the gaps between gusts so each step lands in a lull.

name: Cranequin Largesse
description: Chain the draw and the seat of the bolt into one motion that the wind cannot break.

name: Boltrail Edict
description: Drive a charged bolt through the foe's guard from open ground with nothing to hide behind.

name: Thunderclap Twang
description: Hold in the open with the bow raised while qi builds and loose the whole store at once.

name: Steel Releaseclack
description: Loose a great bolt in the open with full qi so it breaks the guard of the strongest foe.

name: Splendid Span
description: Stand openly in the field and loose one quarrel that trusts its qi alone to pass any guard.

name: Pealstock
description: Take one bearing together along the rank so every bow points at the same mark.

name: Parity Windlass
description: Set the feet against the stones of the plateau to hold the stance in a hard gust.

name: Bloomlatch
description: Issue the bolts along the rank so each shooter carries an equal share.

name: Volition Boltrail
description: Breathe the oath together along the rank so all loose on the same word.

name: Twang Decree
description: Loose along the whole rank on the one bearing so the bolts fly in the same line.

name: Vigor Quarrel
description: Move the rank forward in step while holding the bearing on the mark.

name: Bloom Cranequin
description: Reload in turn along the rank so the oath of the volley is not broken.

name: Reminiscence Latch
description: Read the gusts that sweep the length of the rank and call the offset aloud.

name: Bedrock Tripbar
description: Loose the full rank on the held bearing so a heavy volley covers a broad stretch.

name: Bedrock Setback
description: Hold the rank spanned on the bearing and loose at the word to pin the foe.

name: Entropy Cranking
description: Loose a rank of great bolts along one bearing with full qi so the volley breaks a massed force.

name: Seartriumph
description: Keep the whole rank on one bearing from the first loose to the last so the volley never wavers.

name: Magnanimous Bowprod
description: Stake the foot plate of the heavy prod against the push of the open gale.

name: Gracious Stock
description: Draw the heavy prod on a sworn count with the legs doing most of the work.

name: Revelation Trigger
description: Choose a short stiff bolt from the quiver that will not be lifted by the gale.

name: Vacuum Quarrel
description: Loose the heavy prod in the open wind with the aim set to meet the gale.

name: Twangsolace
description: Shift the heavy prod a step at a time and re-stake it in the lee of a gust.

name: Solar Tripbar
description: Reload the heavy prod between gusts on a steady count with a partner at the crank.

name: Matchless Span
description: Loose a charged heavy bolt in a gale so it drives through a shield and the arm behind it.

name: Thunderclap Bowprod
description: Hold the heavy prod spanned through a gust while qi gathers and then release it.

name: Stirrup Banner
description: Loose a great heavy quarrel with full qi so it breaks heavy cover and the strongest guard.

name: Storied Trigger
description: Loose the braced heavy prod at the peak of a gale so the bolt breaks whatever it strikes.

name: Luminous Latch
description: Plant the feet on bare rock at the edge where there is no shelter and no cover.

name: Stockgift
description: Look out from the edge across the open air and fix the mark below.

name: Solarstock
description: Hold the breath calmly on the open edge where a gust can come from any side.

name: Resounding Twang
description: Loose from the open edge at a mark in the valley below.

name: Bedrock Cranequin
description: Step along the edge with qi in the soles to keep the footing on narrow ground.

name: Benevolent Sear
description: Reload in full view at the edge without losing the line to the mark.

name: Luminous Sear
description: Sense the depth of the drop and how far the mark lies from the foot of the cliff.

name: Setback Crown
description: Loose a charged bolt down from the edge so it pierces the cover of the mark below.

name: Quenched Releaseclack
description: Hold at the open edge while qi gathers and release one bolt at the mark below.

name: Thunderclap Span
description: Loose a great quarrel from the open edge with full qi so it shatters the cover below.

name: Heroic Releaseclack
description: Swear the shot at the open edge and loose a falling bolt that keeps the oath through any guard.

name: Vigorstock
description: Stand tall in the open with the Core steady and the prod raised toward the far sky.

name: Interstice Windlass
description: Read the high wind by the drift of cloud and the lean of the grass far below.

name: Stock Benison
description: Count a slow breath while the Core feeds the arms and the aim settles.

name: Serene Boltrail
description: Rest the prod on a staked fork in the open to ease the arms between shots.

name: Fearless Sear
description: Loose from the raised prod at a far mark beneath the open sky.

name: Delugelatch
description: Move across open ground with the oath held and the prod kept raised.

name: Parity Stock
description: Chain each draw to the Core's breath so the prod is spanned again at once.

name: Revelation Latch
description: Read the whole sky for the shifting wind before the shot is committed.

name: Vacuumstock
description: Loose a Core charged bolt along the sworn line so it pierces plate at long range.

name: Sovereign Cranking
description: Hold the raised prod while the Core gathers and release the whole store in one beat.

name: Stirrup Verdict
description: Loose a great quarrel from the Core so it crosses the open sky and breaks strong cover.

name: Pulsar Stirrup
description: Swear one quarrel to a mark across the far sky and loose it from the full draw of the Core.
